No lifecycle scripts ran. `gh pr view --json baseRefOid` was unsupported by installed gh; exact base/head was read through `gh api` instead. GitHub Actions permissions lookup returned HTTP 403; availability is unknown and remote checks are not claimed passed. No workflows are manually dispatched.

Full static failure preservation:

The exact per-item comparison has no additions and no removals. Raw logs retain every item, including all original rule, path, line, column and message text. No baseline refresh or gate relaxation.
- The full lint records roughly 12 MB per run, so ordinary local WIP logs are retained in the saved environment rather than truncated into a passing summary. Paths: `evidence/base-lint-full.log`, `evidence/candidate-lint-full.log`, `evidence/base-typecheck.log`, `evidence/candidate-typecheck.log`, `evidence/static-comparison.json`, relative to `/workspace/vault-privacy-leaf/`.
